name: Knowt
audience: High school and college students who want notes + flashcards together.
positioning: Notes-first study app with AI-generated flashcards from notes.
strengths: Notes and flashcards in one place
weaknesses: No mind maps, podcasts, or study guides
Smaller feature surface than full study workflows
recentAiFeatures: AI flashcards from notes; AI explanations.
pricingNote: Has free and paid tiers; do not quote prices. Refer to knowt.com.
commonPraise: Easy switch from Quizlet; notes-first workflow feels natural; quick to start.
commonComplaints: AI flashcard quality inconsistent; fewer artifact types than study platforms; mobile rough edges.
positioningVsNomi: Knowt pairs notes with AI flashcards; Nomi adds the rest of the loop — ingestion from PDF/YouTube, mind maps, quizzes, podcasts, study guides, and spaced repetition — so the same source becomes a complete study set, not just notes + cards.
